Symbol:
dbs
Type:
ara::core::Optional< std::uint16_t >
Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint16_t> dbs;
Description:
std::uint16_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined dbs (data block
size) 8 bit header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype IEC68133_IIDC.
The value range for dbs shall be:
0x00 00...0x00 FF : valid
0x00 01...0xFF FF : not used
For transmission, the value of dbs shall be set to the configured value, if it is not provided by the
application.
Visibility:
protected
